name: Benchmarks
description: A RevenueCat feature illustration with an illustrated metrics card and six fixed chart rows, adapted from the designers' Benchmarks artwork.

summary.purpose: Illustrative metrics summary; not computed from the chart

labels.purpose: One label for each fixed chart row

customization.guidance: Preserve short labels and inspect the result for overflow. Props change copy; they do not calculate or redraw metric charts.

dataDisclaimer: This is illustrative design artwork, not a data visualization backed by measured results. The default summary preserves the Figma wording '5/7 metrics above median' although six rows are visible. It is editable copy, not a computed ratio.
